aiProvider.title: AI providers and models
aiProvider.intro: The providers, models and prices LiwanOS pays for, the margin it adds, and which model serves each kind of task at each quality level. Customers on the platform provider, and the free help agents, run on this. Changes reach the AI service within seconds and need no restart.

status.title: In use now
status.none: Nothing has been saved here yet. The AI service keeps running on the file it started with.

delivery.delivered: Delivered to the AI service, revision {revision}
delivery.pending: Saved as revision {revision}, but the AI service has not received it yet
delivery.unconfigured: Saved as revision {revision}, but this control plane has no file to write for the AI service
delivery.incomplete: Saved as revision {revision}, but no default model is chosen, so nothing was written for the AI service

providers.title: Providers
providers.description: Each provider has its own endpoint and key. A key is write-only: once saved it is never shown again, only its last four characters. Save a new provider before listing or testing its models.
providers.empty: No provider yet. Add one below.
providers.idHint: Lowercase letters, digits, _ and -. Left empty, it is taken from the provider.
providers.keyPending: Will be saved with the next save
providers.apiKeyHint: Write it once. It is encrypted at rest and never returned. Leave empty to keep the saved key.
providers.baseUrlHintPrivate: The address of your server, for example http://ollama:11434. This is the only provider that may use a private or internal address. Internal addresses also need an entry in the AI egress list.
providers.baseUrlHintPublic: The public https address of the endpoint, on port 443 (the default). Private, loopback and link-local addresses and other ports are refused.
providers.streamUsageHint: Tick it only if the server accepts stream_options.include_usage. Cost and charge depend on the counts; the model test shows whether they arrive.
providers.saveFirst: Not saved yet: save the configuration, then models of this provider can be listed and tested.
providers.removeBlocked: Used by {models}. Remove or move those models first.
providers.modelsLoaded: {count} models loaded. Pick one in the models table.

models.title: Models and prices
models.description: Prices are in US dollars per million tokens, with at most five decimals. A model can serve charged runs only when it has input and output prices and its last test saw token counts.
models.empty: No model yet. Add one below.
models.name: Model
models.nameHint: Pick from the loaded list or type the name.
models.priceInvalid: A plain decimal with at most five decimals.
models.saveFirst: Not saved yet: save the configuration, then this model can be tested.
models.testReported: The model answered in {ms} ms and reported token usage.
models.testNotReported: The model answered in {ms} ms but reported no token usage, so it cannot serve charged runs.

reason.unpriced: it needs an input and an output price
reason.untested: test it and the provider must report token usage

margin.title: Margin
margin.description: The percentage added to the provider's cost for every platform call. One rate for every model.
margin.label: Margin on cost
margin.invalid: A percentage from 0 to 100 with at most two decimals.
margin.example: A call that costs {cost} USD is charged {charge} USD to the customer.

routes.title: Routes
routes.description: Which model serves each kind of task at each quality level. A cell left to inherit uses the balanced level's model for that task, then the default.
routes.defaultHint: Required for the file to be delivered. Serves every task without its own choice.
routes.quickWarningTitle: Quick is not mapped in the balanced level
routes.quickWarning: Help, setup, titles and classification will run on the default model.

save.title: Save
save.incompleteNote: Without a default model the configuration is stored but nothing is delivered to the AI service.
save.reasonHint: At least 3 characters. It is recorded in the audit log, never a key.
save.confirmDescription: Every platform AI request uses the new providers, prices and routes within seconds. The change is audited.

blockers.providerKey: A provider needs an API key.
blockers.modelId: A model name is not valid or is used twice.
blockers.modelName: A model needs the name it has at its provider.
blockers.modelProvider: A model points to a provider that is not in the list.

idProblem.invalid: Use 1 to 32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, _ and -, starting with a letter.

test.model_not_found: The provider does not know this model.

test.endpoint_refused: This address is not allowed: it is, or resolves to, a private or internal address.

errors.step_up_required: Confirm with your passkey, then try again.
